title: DFG benchmark 2D-1: steady flow around a cylinder in a channel, Re = 20 (Schaefer & Turek 1996)
description:
Steady laminar flow of an incompressible Newtonian fluid around a circular cylinder in a 2D channel (the DFG / Schaefer-Turek 'flow around a cylinder' benchmark, steady case).
Geometry (STEP, planar face in the xy-plane): channel 0 <= x <= 2.2, 0 <= y <= 0.41 m with a circular hole (the cylinder) of diameter D = 0.1 m centred at (0.2, 0.2). Model it as 2D; report forces per metre of depth (out-of-plane thickness 1 m).
Fluid: density rho = 1.0 kg/m^3, dynamic viscosity mu = 0.001 Pa s.
Boundary conditions:
  inlet x = 0: parabolic velocity profile u_x(y) = 4 U_m y (H - y) / H^2 with U_m = 0.3 m/s,
    i.e. u_x = 7.138607971445569*y*(0.41 - y)  [m/s, y in m],  u_y = 0
  outlet x = 2.2: static pressure p = 0 Pa
  channel walls y = 0 and y = 0.41, and the cylinder surface: no slip
Report (SI units):
  drag            x-component of the total force (pressure + viscous) of the fluid on the cylinder [N per m depth]
  lift            y-component of that force [N per m depth]
  dp_front_rear   static pressure difference p(front) - p(rear) between the points (0.15, 0.2) and (0.25, 0.2) on the cylinder surface [Pa]
The force QoIs refer to the boundary group cylinder: use this name for the cylinder surface group of the mesh.
